title: cacalia salzmannii
intro: Cacalia salzmannii, commonly known as Salzmann's Cacalia or Sichuan Cacalia, is a plant species in the family Compositae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia salzmannii include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which may help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
